title: Florida House, District 13
what_it_does: Represents District 13 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Open seat: Democratic Rep. Angie Nixon is running for U.S. Senate. Audrey Gibson won the Aug. 18 Democratic primary over Leslie Jean-Bart; her only November opponent is a write-in candidate, so the write-in's name will not appear on the ballot.
verified_ballot_note: CBS Miami / News Service of Florida (Aug. 19, 2026) reported Audrey Gibson defeated Leslie Jean-Bart in the HD 13 Democratic primary and that 'her only general election opponent is a write-in candidate' (https://www.cbsnews.com/miami/news/florida-house-senate-primary-election-results-2026/). The write-in's name was not found. Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.

candidates.name: Audrey Gibson
candidates.background: Former state senator (2011-2022) and former state representative (2002-2010) from Jacksonville. Won the Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic primary for the open HD 13 seat over Leslie Jean-Bart.
candidates.primary_result: Won Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic primary over Leslie Jean-Bart (CBS Miami)
